name: shadcn/ui and typeset (copied source)
reason: Reviewed local adaptations of shadcn/ui base-vega wrappers and shadcn/typeset. components.json and the typeset source identify upstream provenance; original introduction commits 955fcc6 and 1e85efc. Historical upstream revisions were not recorded, so this identity is a repository import, not an invented upstream version. Preserve the upstream MIT grant independently of the installed CLI.
